status: Knowledge contracts; not ten newly implemented engines

mechanisms.name: Editorial Time and Beat Map
mechanisms.fields: shot_id, source_range, output_range, fps_num, fps_den, cue_id, time_mapping
mechanisms.invalidation: Cut/hold/retime invalidates cues, animation, simulation and affected encoded ranges.

mechanisms.name: Speech and Semantic Cues
mechanisms.fields: utterance_id, speaker_id, exact_text, audio_asset_id, start, end, precision, alignment_source
mechanisms.invalidation: Transcript edits invalidate captions/emphasis; audio replacement also invalidates word/viseme timing.

mechanisms.name: Visual Grammar and References
mechanisms.fields: reference_id, property_role, observed_cues, inferred_regions, styleframe_id, revision
mechanisms.invalidation: Changed targets invalidate affected reconstruction/style checks, not every source asset.

mechanisms.name: Layout and Priority
mechanisms.invalidation: New camera, copy, font or placement invalidates time-dependent layout evidence.

mechanisms.name: Motion and Camera
mechanisms.fields: object_id, local_time, transform_space, pivot, evaluator, interpolation, shutter
mechanisms.invalidation: Retiming/pivot/rig changes invalidate related contact, projected bounds and sampled frames.

mechanisms.name: Assets and Components
mechanisms.fields: asset_id, immutable_source, revision, source_hash, license, overrides, source_to_output_map
mechanisms.invalidation: New asset versions invalidate consumers; overrides require explicit migration.

mechanisms.name: Tracking and Compositing
mechanisms.fields: track_id, source_coordinates, output_transform, confidence, mask_alpha, valid_intervals
mechanisms.invalidation: Reframe/retime changes invalidate track projection; source replacement invalidates tracking itself.

mechanisms.name: Audio Cues and Mix
mechanisms.fields: stem_id, sample_rate, decoded_samples, cue_offsets, gain_envelope, provenance
mechanisms.invalidation: Speech timing changes invalidate caption/lip-sync cues; gain edits invalidate mix review.

mechanisms.name: Scene Render and Export
mechanisms.fields: scene_id, state_at_frame, build_signature, renderer_version, frame_range, output_variant
mechanisms.invalidation: Changed dependencies invalidate matching frame caches and downstream exports.

mechanisms.name: Platform Profiles and QA
mechanisms.fields: profile_id, platform, placement, format, ui_variant, verified_at, status, evidence_scope
mechanisms.invalidation: Profile changes invalidate placement review; structural checks never certify artistic quality.
